set.body:
Source: plan phase 1.

Problem:
The 2026-07-25 review produced two documentation-derived claims about Slurm CLI contracts. One was right (squeue exits non-zero for a departed job), one was wrong (sacct does have --array). A 50 percent hit rate on careful reading is the argument for capture over inference, and it implies more wrong assumptions remain.

The enabling insight: the disposable controller can produce far more evidence than the squeue-absence transcript it was built for. sbatch --hold followed by scancel yields real CANCELLED accounting rows with real exit codes, with no worker registration and no site allocation. That moves a large part of P6f.5a and P6f.16 onto a laptop.

Scope:
- Generalize tools/disposable-slurm/capture-squeue-absence.sh into capture.sh <scenario>, sharing build/start/provenance scaffolding.
- Scenarios in value order: squeue-absence (exists, never run); sacct-cancelled (real accounting rows for a cancelled held array); scontrol-show-job (real spaced-value Reason and Command); capability-probes (real sbatch --version, squeue --json=list, scontrol show config).
- Every scenario captures raw streams plus provenance with digests and writes NO expected result. Deciding what a fixture asserts stays a reviewed step.
- Any contract a capture contradicts becomes its own bead.

Acceptance:
- Each scenario produces a provenance-complete directory.
- At least one existing synthetic fixture is replaced by actual-binary evidence, with supportClaim still honestly false.

Risk: gated on a Docker daemon that would not start on the review machine. Nothing else in the plan depends on this phase.

Note: capture-squeue-absence.sh has never been executed or syntax-checked. Treat its first run as part of the capture.
set.title: P7.1: Generalize the disposable-controller capture harness
